tenderSchedule.title: CDPO ROUTE
tenderSchedule.description:
INVITING A TENDER FOR PROVIDING A VEHICLE(MGV/MINIMUM 05 MT CAPACITY) 
 FOR TRANSPORTING WHOLE MILK POWDER OF KSHEERA BHAGYA SCHEME FROM 
 CHANNARAYAPATTANA MILK CHILLING CENTER GODOWN TO HASSAN, KODAGU
 AND CHIKKAMAGALURU DISTRICTS CHILD DEVALOPMENT PROJECT OFFICES 
 GODOWN(18 CDPO GODOWNS).
 THE BIDDER SHOULD QUOTE RATE PER METRIC TON BASIS ONLY(THE QUOTE 
 RATE INCLUDING TRANSPORTING OF MILK POWDER FROM CHANNARAYAPATTANA 
 MILK CHILLING CENTER GODOWN TO 18 CDPO TALUKS GODOWNS, LOADING AND 
 UNLOADING OF MILK POWDER AND TOLL FEE).
 APPROX 50 MT PER MONTH TO BE SUPPLIED.
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka Co-operative Milk Producers Federation Limited
tenderSchedule.locationName: Managing Director Hassan Co-operative Milk Producers Union Union Pvt (PI)

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
THE BIDDER SHOULD FOLLOW ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF TENDER DOCUMENT
